depiction.primary_object: seated person silhouette next to a windshield defroster symbol
modifiers: windshield frame with two wavy heat lines
depiction.composition: side view of seated figure on right, defroster and down arrow on left

readings.meaning: car climate control / windshield defroster and footwell airflow

ambiguity: Specialized automotive dashboard symbol (defrost + floor airflow mode); at small sizes the windshield arch and wavy lines look like an abstract box or shower head above an arrow.

reasoning: This is the standard automotive dashboard glyph for the defrost-and-floor airflow mode (windshield defroster symbol above a downward arrow next to a seated passenger). It fits narrow car HVAC, defroster, or cabin heater repair tasks, though outside a dashboard context it can look like a puzzling combination of a person sitting and an arrow.
